data.power_entity: Power sensor for this appliance (in watts)
data.running_entity: Binary contact that is on while the AC louver is open
data.mail_motion_entity: Interior motion sensor that detects incoming mail
data.mail_slot_entity: Contact on the mailbox flap used to insert letters

data_description.running_entity: Mount the contact on the AC louver. An open louver means the air conditioner is running.
data_description.mail_motion_entity: Motion inside the mailbox indicates that a letter has arrived.
data_description.mail_slot_entity: Opening the mail-slot flap indicates that a letter has arrived.
data_description.washer_door_entity: An open contact means the washer door is open.
data_description.dishwasher_door_entity: An open contact means the dishwasher door is open.
data_description.dryer_door_entity: An open contact means the dryer door is open.
data_description.refrigerator_door_entity: An open contact means the refrigerator door is open.
data_description.smart_plug_entity: Select the smart switch connected to the refrigerator; on means it is powered and off means it is not running.
data_description.refrigerator_switch_door_entity: An open contact means the refrigerator door is open.
data_description.mailbox_motion_door_entity: An open contact means the mailbox's main door is open; opening it clears pending mail.
data_description.mailbox_slot_door_entity: An open contact means the mailbox's main door is open; opening it clears pending mail.
data_description.plug_entity: The integration can also provide a switch. Turning it off will abruptly cut power to the appliance.

parameters.title: Type-specific parameters
parameters.description: Parameters depend on the selected profile. If no fields are shown, this profile has no configurable parameters.

data.start_power_w: Power above which a cycle is considered started (W)
data.start_duration_seconds: Seconds power must stay above the start level before confirming the cycle
data.finish_power_w: Power below which a cycle is considered finished (W)
data.finish_duration_seconds: Seconds power must stay below the finish level before confirming the cycle has ended
data.pending_delay_seconds: Wait after the cycle before the first unload reminder
data.pending_repeats: Additional reminders after the first one (3 means 4 total)
data.door_open_delay_seconds: Seconds the refrigerator door may stay open before the alarm
data.compressor_inactive_delay_seconds: Seconds without compressor activity before the alarm
data.alarm_repeat_count: Additional alarms after the initial alarm (3 means 4 total)

data_description.max_runtime_seconds: Optional. Leave blank to disable. If the cycle is still running after this time, the actions you configure for this limit run once; the appliance is not stopped.

data.start_actions: Actions to run when the cycle starts
data.finish_actions: Actions to run when the cycle finishes
data.max_runtime_actions: Actions to run once if the maximum cycle time is exceeded
data.pending_actions: Actions to repeat while waiting to unload (requires a door sensor)
data.door_open_actions: Actions to run while the refrigerator door alarm is active
data.compressor_inactive_actions: Actions to run while the compressor inactivity alarm is active
data.mail_arrival_actions: Actions to run when mail is detected

error.invalid_thresholds: Check that finish power is below start power and all times are valid.
error.invalid_pending_settings: The initial delay must be a positive whole number and repetitions a non-negative whole number.
error.invalid_alarm_settings: Alarm delays and repeat interval must be positive whole numbers; additional repeats must be a non-negative whole number.
